tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: event feed, hold queue, detail panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Selected feed row, code wells for argv and effects.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between feed rows. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and panel edges that must be seen (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (cwd, user, latency) on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: allow-ink
tokens.usage: The allow verdict: outline and text only, no fill, so allowed traffic recedes.

tokens.name: lattice
tokens.usage: Quiet pattern ink, for patterns drawn behind cover art and empty states. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Magenta red, the brand color. Fill for the block verdict and the deny button; the brand accent in the shader and patterns.

tokens.name: on-rose
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a rose fill.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Rose as text: block reasons and effects that caused a block, on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Teal, rose's complement. Means a person is needed: fill for hold and approve.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a teal fill.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal as text: hold countdowns, the exploring chip, on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: sg-rose
tokens.usage: ShaderGradient color1. Darker than rose on purpose: ShaderGradient's lighting brightens its inputs, and this lands on rose.

tokens.name: sg-teal
tokens.usage: ShaderGradient color2. Lands on teal after lighting.

tokens.name: sg-shadow
tokens.usage: ShaderGradient color3, the folds' shadow.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name. Once per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wrote a cron job that runs a file from /tmp as root.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field names in the detail panel only. Sentence case, no wide tracking.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: Verdict chips only. The single place uppercase is allowed.

styles.name: argv
styles.usage: Program path and arguments, paths, effects.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip padding, glyph gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a feed row between fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Feed row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page margin on wide screens; space above the wordmark.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels and feed rows. Crystal is square; facets come from the cut, not from rounding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips, just enough to soften the pixel edge.

cut.note: The facet cut: a chamfer on one corner made with clip-path. The identity motif.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Verdict chips: top-right corner.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Hold cards and the detail panel: top-right corner.
